question.text: Out of 7 consonants and 4 vowels, words are formed each having 3 consonants and 2 vowels. The number of such words that can be formed is

solution.text:
Out of 7 consonants, the number of ways of selecting 3 consonants $={ }^{7} C_{3}$ 
Similarly, number of ways of selecting
2 vowels out of 4 vowels $={ }^{4} C_{2}$
$\therefore$ Total number of words formed
$$
\begin{array}{l}
={ }^{7} C_{3} \times{ }^{4} C_{2} \times{ }^{5} P_{5} \\
=\frac{7 \times 6 \times 5}{3 \times 2 \times 1} \times \frac{4 \times 3}{2 \times 1} \times 51 \\
=7 \times 5 \times 2 \times 3 \times 120=25200
\end{array}
$$
